objective: Define a CAT-owned forward-only coverage epoch that can make future supply windows complete without reconstructing or rewriting pre-ledger visibility history.

rootCause.activationStateImmutable: CAT-A06 correctly records that no non-synthetic baseline was performed at activation.
rootCause.persistentCoverageGap: Listings already visible before CAT-A06 can remain active without a ledger opening event, so partial coverage can persist indefinitely.
rootCause.forbiddenShortcut: Changing the original activation timestamp/policy or inferring publish time from mutable current rows would fabricate history.

strategy.observationTimestampAuthority: server transaction timestamp inside one consistent database transaction

rules: For a service with prior ledger facts, current eligibility must equal the latest eligible_after; mismatch aborts rather than repairs.
For a currently eligible service with prior facts, current visible version and frozen dimensions must be compatible with the latest ledger state; unexplained drift aborts.
A deleted/missing service whose latest ledger fact is eligible_after=true aborts because an unrecorded close would exist.
No source row or ledger row may be mutated to make preflight pass.

baselineWriteContract.sequenceRule: next monotonic sequence_no for each service
baselineWriteContract.eligibleBeforeRule: latest eligible_after when a prior fact exists; false when no prior fact exists
baselineWriteContract.eligibleAfterRule: current CAT public-visibility eligibility at baseline timestamp
baselineWriteContract.visibleVersionAfterRule: current approved visible version when eligible_after=true; null otherwise
baselineWriteContract.dimensionAfterRule: freeze current CAT category/state snapshot when eligible_after=true; null otherwise
baselineWriteContract.retryRule: same baselineRunId+serviceId is idempotent; a distinct authorized baseline run is a distinct occurrence

coverageEpoch.futureAuthority: private CAT-owned append-only coverage epoch record
certifiedOnlyAfter: full current-service scan completed in the same baseline transaction
one baseline occurrence exists for every current service
event counts and service counts reconcile
source and ledger fingerprints are recorded
no CAT lifecycle row was mutated
coverageEpoch.completenessRule: windows with windowStart before coverageCompleteFrom remain partial; windows with windowStart at or after a certified coverageCompleteFrom may be complete if all later ledger events are structurally valid and ANA freshness is satisfied

maturity.reason: CAT-A07 forward baseline and certified coverage epoch are active in staging and ANA-A10 consumes the epoch. CAT remains 4/6; ANA remains 3/6 because freshness policy/cadence is still unset and broader domain blockers remain.
